prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which player who scored more than 10 goals in the 2022 Argentine Premier League season also played for Elche in Spain?
answer: None. The players who scored more than 10 goals in Argentina’s 2022 Primera División were Mateo Retegui (19), Franco Cristaldo (14), and Enzo Copetti (11); none played for Elche CF in Spain as of August 1, 2024.
